events.text: U-38 was used as a training boat in the 24th and 21st U-boat Flotillas.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From December 1941 until November 1943 , U-38 was used as a training boat in the 24th and 21st U-boat Flotillas .

events.text: U-38's use as a training boat ended.
